groups.defect: before_validation calls sub! on a nil host, which raises NoMethodError instead of returning a validation error.
groups.rationale: Both report the same missing nil guard in the before_validation block.

groups.defect: In update/destroy, where(...).first can return nil, so an unknown id raises NoMethodError instead of returning 404.
groups.rationale: Same nil dereference in the same controller actions, with the same fix.

groups.defect: The test 'is false if embeddable_host is blank' no longer exercises the host condition: it passes vacuously and its name is misleading.
groups.rationale: Both say this test's name describes a host check that the code and the setup no longer exercise.

groups.defect: Migration indexes [0]['id'] on a possibly empty embed_category result, which crashes before the fallback runs; the uncategorized_category_id lookup on line 15 has the same problem.
groups.rationale: All three report the same unguarded row access in the migration; two of them also flag line 15.

groups.defect: The plural *_ids hydration branch leaves undefined entries for missing records and has no guard like the singular branch. It also crashes on null ids, and it always deletes/replaces the key, which changes the model's shape.
groups.rationale: Both report that the new plural branch produces arrays with undefined entries because it lacks the singular branch's guard.

groups.defect: record_for_host lowercases only the DB column, not the lookup host or the stored value. It also compares only uri.host, even though validation allows stored hosts with ports.
groups.rationale: s_4b5af67b reports both the case-normalization defect (shared with s_d78df7ae) and the port mismatch (shared with s_721295fb), so these overlapping suggestions chain into one group.

groups.defect: The contents of the category and embeddable_host fabricator files are swapped.
Typo 'emeddable' in the describe name. Also, the context fabricates an embeddable host that the method under test never reads.
groups.rationale: Both report the same typo in the describe string; s_c864cfd5 also flags the inert fabrication.
